source_row.extraction_instructions:
Listing at /events (301s to /news-events/events), paginated ?page=0..3 (0-indexed, page 0 = no query param), ~34 upcoming cards mixing 'Event' badge (news-events/events/) and 'Course' badge (education-careers/courses/rcpch-course|rcpch-webinar/). Detail pages share one DOM shape gated by a cs-/ev- field prefix: Views EVA date/time blocks with tags (1 = single-day, 2 = start/end), a Drupal address field for location (absent field = online-only or unpublished venue, not free text), a fee field rendered as either
  • Label - £NNN
or a

with
-separated 'Label: £NNN' lines under a 'Section:' header line, or free-form 'this is a free event' prose, or absent entirely (no fee published, must stay []). .field--name-field-sh-body is the one clean content div for description/CPD text (no nav leakage). .tags a[href^='/topic/'] gives a deterministic specialty backstop, more reliable than the shared keyword classifier for this source.

registry_comment: RCPCH (Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health) — events + courses/webinars, paginated static HTML, cs-/ev- shared field shape

spot_check.extractor_says:
Fixed 2026-09-23: was picking up the CivicCookieControl consent-banner's injected '

This site uses cookies to store information on your computer.

' when http_fetch fell back to reading the already-navigated LIVE Playwright page (loaded_page path, taken when httpx is blocked e.g. on CI runner IPs) — that banner text only exists as a JSON config string in the raw server HTML, never a real element, so a direct httpx fetch never showed the bug. Both event and course detail pages consistently render the real title as `

`, so the h1 lookup now targets 'h1.page-header, h1' in order and additionally rejects any h1 whose text matches /cookies?/i as a belt-and-braces guard. Re-verified with a forced-fallback repro (http_fetch._fetch_httpx monkeypatched to always report blocked) hitting this exact URL: conference_name now correctly resolves to 'Trainee Research Network Education Seminars (TREES)'. Re-ran the full harness (normal + --force-fallback, 35 shells either way) afterwards — no other row showed cookie-banner or blank titles.

concerns: RCPCH never publishes a numeric CPD-points count on any of the ~10 detail pages probed (unlike RCP/RCEM). cpd_points stays None for every row; cpd_accredited is only True when the body-box content itself mentions 'CPD' — this will legitimately be False for most rows. Not a bug, just a source characteristic.

pricing_tiers is [] for a real subset of rows (e.g. the flagship RCPCH/NIHR Technology Conference, TREES, some webinars) because the source genuinely publishes no fee field on those pages, not because extraction failed — confirmed by hand for the Technology Conference.

event_type is intentionally left unset by the extractor for most rows; shell['category'] is set to 'course'/'workshop' only for Course-badged / webinar-URL cards, and Event-badged cards are left for the shared title-keyword heuristic + 'conference' default (verified this correctly turns '... Training Day' into workshop and '... Conference' into conference without a source-specific rule).

Some detail pages route booking through third-party platforms (eventsforce.net, forms.office.com, forms.cloud.microsoft, events.teams.microsoft.com, hrc-children.nihr.ac.uk) rather than staying on rcpch.ac.uk — booking_url correctly follows the on-page link, but these are out of scope to crawl further for pricing/venue (per the multipage-detail playbook, subpage-walking only applies to same-domain marketing subsites, not third-party registration forms).

Did not find any genuine multi-session 'one course, many dates' listing on RCPCH — recurring courses (Statement and report writing, Effective Educational Supervision) each publish a SEPARATE listing card + detail URL per dated run, so this extractor deliberately does NOT use the sessions[]/course_sessions pattern. If a future RCPCH offering does bundle multiple dates into one detail page, this extractor will need updating.

Audit-gate fix (2026-09-23): the h1 lookup for conference_name previously used a bare `document.querySelector('h1')`, which could pick up the site's CivicCookieControl consent-banner h1 instead of the real title when http_fetch fell back to reading the already-navigated live browser page (the path taken when httpx is blocked, e.g. on GitHub Actions runner IPs). Confirmed this affects BOTH /news-events/events/* and /education-careers/courses/* pages equally (both share the identical `h1.page-header` wrapper and the same consent-banner script), not just courses. Fixed by targeting `h1.page-header` first and rejecting any h1 whose text matches /cookies?/i. Verified with a forced-fallback repro against the exact flagged URL (TREES) and a full harness re-run (normal + --force-fallback, 35/35 shells, no cookie-banner titles anywhere).
